title: #3147 acceptance 'randomized p=10,q=2 recovers top-k within 1%' is false without a spectral-decay precondition
evidence: trueno::Svd::randomized on a 160x120 matrix with harmonic spectrum 1/i: k=20 worst top-k relative error 1.80e-2 at q=2 (sigma_31/sigma_20 = 0.68); k<=10 (ratio <= 0.5) and geometric 0.9^i at k<=20 are under 1%; q=6 restores <1% at k=20
